entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with G.R. Case No.734 of 2025 pending on the file of learned SDJM, Pallahara, arising out of Pallahara P.S. Case No.341 of 2025 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 376(1) of I.P.C. read with Section 67(A)/ 66(E) of the I.T. Act.

3. Learned counsel for the State, on instruction, submits that in the case at hand the charge sheet has been filed and the Petitioner is not cited as an accused.
4. In view of the same, the ABLAPL stands disposed of.
Signed by: SOUMYA RANJAN SAMAL
